must_identify.item: The api Service targetPort is 9090 while the api container listens on 8080, so connections from the frontend are refused (502)
must_identify.evidence: The root cause was a configuration drift on the `api` Service in namespace shop: the live Service spec had `targetPort: 9090` [13, 15], while the Deployment's container only exposes `containerPort: 8080` [11] and the application code binds to the `PORT` environment variable with a default of 8080... producing connection-refused errors for every Service-routed request — manifesting as nginx's 502 responses on `/api/` [7, 14].

must_identify.item: The worker's warnings and errors are not the cause of the frontend 5xx
must_identify.evidence: Health and configuration of the redis, worker, and loadgen deployments — no symptoms or alerts pointed to these components, so they were not examined.

notes: The RCA never looked at the worker and never mentions its DeprecationWarning or metrics-push errors. It excludes the worker only implicitly, by listing it as not examined. The RCA says 'the fix was validated but not applied' without stating the fix. Restoring targetPort to 8080 is strongly implied by the last-applied-configuration evidence, but it is never stated explicitly.
